subject: POC scheduling and capacity playbook — hosted vs dedicated planning
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@quantified.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: POC kickoff — hands-on session + capacity planning

Thanks all — we want to kick off a hands-on POC for Quantified AI. Primary goals: run a prompt review (2-3 representative prompts), validate routing behavior across short/long contexts, and do a light load test to estimate token burn and peak QPS.

Can we schedule a 90-min working session during the week of Sept 20? Prefer mornings PST. A few clarifying points that will help your prep:
- Expected steady QPS: ~30 requests/sec, peaks ~120 QPS for 10–15s
- Typical prompt length: 400–800 tokens; outputs average 250 tokens
- We expect to try both Hosted and Dedicated options; procurement needs indicative quota/cost and a sample token budget.

I'll loop in procurement in the next email for timeline constraints. Please suggest 3 slots. Thanks —

— Alex
Principal AI Engineer
Quantified AI

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: POC kickoff — hands-on session + capacity planning

Hi Alex — thanks for the details, this is helpful.
We can do a 90-min hands-on session. Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2027-09-21 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2027-09-22 10:30–12:00
- Thu 2027-09-23 08:30–10:00

To make the capacity guidance accurate, could you confirm:
1) peak concurrent users during the 120 QPS spike (approx sessions vs parallel requests)
2) whether you will enable streaming outputs for the test (impacts per-connection resource usage)
3) any corporate IP allowlist constraints for a Dedicated trial

We'll bring a short token-budget spreadsheet and a sample Dedicated trial plan. Attendees from our side: me (AE), Ben (Enterprise AE), Monica (Solutions Engineer), Kimberly (Security SME), Vivek (Infra SE). I'll hold the Tue slot tentatively while you check procurement.

— Priyom
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Alex — quick note on logistics and offers from our side:
- We can start you on Hosted with a temporary quota bump to match the spike (up to 150 QPS) for the pilot. If you need guaranteed throughput, we can spin a 2-week Dedicated pilot (fast provision) pending a short MOU.
- I'll attach a token-budget template that maps request shape → estimated token burn and cost. Use it to plug in your 30/120 QPS numbers.
- Pricing for a small Dedicated pool is included in the template; we can talk discounts if you commit to a 3-month follow-on.

Attaching: POC-Token-Budget.xlsx (spreadsheet)

— Ben
